title.narrative: Reducing Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emissions through Improved Energy Efficiency in the Industrial Sector in Georgia

description.narrative: The project aims at reducing GHG emissions in the industrial sector of Georgia through the promotion and implementation support of selected industrial energy efficiency best-available practices and technologies, including i) energy management systems and standards in line with ISO 50001; ii) energy system optimization; iii) sector specific technologies. 15.11.2016. MM - Project development started targeting Armenia and Georgia, but after consultations with the donor it was decided to focus the fully-fledged project only on Georgia
